title: Velocity Optimized
description: Velocity Optimized focuses on improving performance by making everything run faster and smoother. It reduces lag, increases FPS, shortens load times, and removes unnecessary processes by using carefully selected and configured optimizations.
body:
Velocity Optimized improves performance through smart optimizations that boost FPS, reduce lag, and increase stability. It delivers faster load times and smoother gameplay without altering core mechanics.

_**Notes: you may want to allocate more Memory to the modpack 4 or 8 GB is enough. Personally i use 16 Gb you can use 16 Gb if you want too.**_
